descriptions.g5c_aligned_allocate_80213a8c: Allocates aligned native heap storage. Alignments up to8 delegate to the original allocator; larger requests normalize alignment to a power of two of at least16 and round the chunk size to the observed minimum16/eight-byte boundary. Oversized byte counts set original errno12. Overallocates, splits and releases a leading fragment when required, preserves mapped-chunk predecessor metadata for flag2, then releases a trailing fragment when larger than16. Uses byte cursors through externally allocated variable-sized chunks; constructs no local aggregate and owns no initialized data. Allocator and chunk roles are inferred.
